title: AMFI Scheme Master Record - HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund (118989)

sections.content: AMFI Scheme Code: 118989. Scheme Name: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Direct Plan - Growth Option. ISIN: INF179K01BF8. Scheme Type: Open Ended. Category: Equity - Mid Cap Fund. Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA): Computer Age Management Services Limited (CAMS).

Net Asset Value (NAV) is computed and published on all business days by 11:00 PM on the AMFI portal. Cut-off time for subscription and redemption orders is 3:00 PM on business days. Redemption payout turnaround time is within T+2 business days direct to verified bank accounts.
